title: Schedule of Deposits: Deposit Balance on a Moved In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
**Clause M-1.** The deposit balance owed on a moved In-Person Appointments visit is the deposit the moved visit requires less the deposit held on it, and nothing where that difference is zero or less.

**Clause M-2.** The deposit held on the moved visit is the total of the deposits collected on it less the total already released from it, as its fee and deposit history shows.

**Clause M-3.** The deposit the moved visit requires is the visit type's self-pay booking deposit, from the schedule of self-pay booking deposits. It is worked out on the day the balance is paid, in one order: the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is raised first; sums added to the deposit the moved visit requires then apply to that product; and the deposit the moved visit requires is rounded to the cent before the deposit held is taken off it.

### Worked example (hypothetical)

An Established Patient Office Visit, self-pay booking deposit 75.00, moved by the patient.

| Deposits collected | Released | Deposit held | Deposit the moved visit requires | Balance owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $75.00 | $0.00 | $75.00 | $75.00 | nothing (difference 0.00) |
| $50.00 | $0.00 | $50.00 | $75.00 | $25.00 |
| $100.00 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $75.00 | nothing (difference below zero) |

### Points of judgement

- The balance is never negative: a deposit held above the deposit the moved visit requires leaves nothing owed.
- Rounding to the cent is applied to the deposit the moved visit requires before the deposit held is subtracted.
